product_metadata.title: Zak Designs Marvel Spider-Man Kids Water Bottle with Spout Cover and Carrying Loop, Durable Plastic, Leak-Proof Design for Travel (16 oz, 2-Pack, Spidey and His Amazing Friends)
features: SIZE: This set contains two Zak PP water bottles with a 16-ounce capacity, each measuring 6.61 inches tall and 4.23 by 2.75 inches wide. The BPA-free water bottles are recommended for children ages 3+.
MATERIAL: These travel water bottles are made of break-resistant plastic that is durable and BPA-free. They're top rack dishwasher safe; do not microwave.

SECURE CLOSURE: The flip-up spout doesn't leak when it's closed, but still allows easy access to water when open. The spout cover releases with the push of a button and has a flip-up lock to hold it in place, preventing leaks and spills.

FEATURES: The leak-proof water bottle with screw-on lid prevents splashes and mess, and fits in most car cup holders for convenient travel. The drinking straw can be removed for cleaning and the spout is comfortable for kids to drink from.

LIFESTYLE: Staying hydrated is an important part of being healthy! With iconic graphics featuring Spidey and His Amazing Friends, Zak Designs' innovative Marvel water bottles help make it easy for grown-ups and fun for kids!
description: "Let kids enjoy hydration with fun Spider-Man water bottles by Zak Designs! Reusable and Durable Material: Reusable water bottles will last wash after wash; good for you and good for the environment! The 16 oz water bottle is made of PP plastic, durable enough for kids to use every day. Leak-Proof Lid: The lid screws on securely and won't leak when the spout is closed, though water flows for easy drinking when the spout is open. The easy-open button has a flip-up lock to keep it from activating accidentally. On the Go: The water bottle has a built-in carrying loop on the lid for easy transportation, and with the spout cover to keep the spout clean and closed, it can be tossed into a bag for worry-free travel. Specifications: Set includes 2 water bottles. 16 oz capacity. Made of durable plastic. BPA-Free - Zak is committed to safety. Dishwasher safe, do not microwave. Length: 4.23-inch, Width: 2.75-inch, Height: 6.61-inch. Character: Spider-Man (Marvel Spidey and His Amazing Friends)."
